title: 2020 BCI competition, track 3
description: EEG recordings from 15 participants performing imagined speech of five commands ("Hello", "Help me", "Stop", "Thank you", "Yes"), released for the 2020 BCI Competition Track 3. The data are split into training, validation and test runs to support machine-learning decoding of imagined speech for brain-computer interfaces. The dataset was converted from the original MATLAB files to BIDS-compliant EDF with trial annotations.
methods_description: 64-channel EEG sampled at 256 Hz during imagined speech trials. Original MATLAB/HDF5 competition files were converted to continuous EDF recordings scaled to Volts, with events marking the onset, duration and command label of each trial. Test set labels came from the competition answer sheet.
